outcomes.name: Adoption has been re-engaged so that required capability levels have been defined and assessed
Adoption has been re-engaged so that people can perform confidently in the future state
Adoption has been re-engaged so that capability and confidence are sustained and continuously improved

actions.action: M Re-engage teams to address: recognise that people will require new capabilities and confidence to operate successfully in the future state.
M Re-open discussions with leaders, managers and stakeholders about future capability requirements.
M Diagnose areas where new skills, behaviours or ways of working may be required.
M Re-engage teams to address: begin raising awareness of future capability expectations and support requirements.
S Diagnose potential capability and confidence challenges that may affect successful adoption.
M Re-engage teams to address: gain initial agreement that capability development and confidence building will be required as part of the change.
S Diagnose stakeholder perceptions regarding confidence, preparedness and future capability needs.
S Diagnose gaps in lessons learned from previous changes relating to capability gaps and confidence challenges.
M Revisit and clarify and document the future-state capabilities required for successful adoption.
M Re-engage teams to address: conduct structured capability analysis to identify gaps between current and future-state requirements.
S Diagnose current confidence levels across impacted stakeholder groups.
M Diagnose factors that may increase or reduce stakeholder confidence during the transition.
S Diagnose capability and confidence risks that could affect successful adoption and performance.
M Rebuild capability-building interventions to address identified capability gaps.
S Re-engage teams to address: provide opportunities for practical application of learning in real or simulated environments.
S Re-engage teams to address: provide coaching, mentoring and peer support opportunities for individuals applying new skills.
M re-communicate expectations regarding performance, proficiency and future-state behaviours.
S Re-establish measures to assess capability development and confidence growth.
S Gather fresh evidence on feedback about confidence levels and practical challenges experienced by users.
S Re-engage teams to address: ensure practical capability is assessed through observation, walkthroughs or structured validation activities.
S Re-engage teams to address: target additional support towards individuals or groups with lower confidence levels.
S Re-establish monitoring of capability and confidence risks during implementation.
S Diagnose gaps in capability and confidence measures through programme governance.
M Re-engage teams to address: ensure there are processes in place to validate that individuals can successfully perform required activities within the future-state environment.
S Re-measure capability attainment and confidence levels across impacted stakeholder groups.
M Re-engage teams to address: ensure effective application of new skills, behaviours and capabilities are recognised and reinforced.
S Re-engage teams to address: provide targeted capability development and confidence-building interventions where gaps remain.
S Re-validate that capability and confidence levels are sufficient to support sustainable performance improvement.
S Gather fresh evidence on stakeholder feedback regarding confidence, performance and practical application of learning.
S re-communicate capability achievements, confidence improvements and examples of successful application.
M Re-embed and continuously improve capability development into organisational learning and development practices.
S Re-establish monitoring of long-term capability, proficiency and confidence trends across the organisation.
S Re-engage teams to address: benchmark capability and confidence maturity across programmes, teams and organisational areas.
M Recover mechanisms that monitor workforce confidence, development needs and emerging capability requirements.
S Re-engage teams to address: recognise and reward sustained demonstration of future-state capabilities and behaviours.
S Re-promote a culture of continuous learning, confidence building and professional growth.
